title: Wren and the Veil
author: Juniper Dunmore
blurb: Quentin Eriksen, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
